description: Free: the daily track record of a paid x402 or MPP endpoint from the x402 Trust Index: on how many of the last 30 scanned days an agent could pay it, the latest verdict and reasons, price and networks. found: false when it is not in the index; add your own endpoint with x402_trust_add. Limited to 10 calls per hour. Before paying, x402_preflight ($0.001) checks the live 402 and includes this record.

url.description: The x402 endpoint (public http(s) URL), e.g. https://api.example.com/paid

name: x402_trust_record

days_payable.description: Days the daily scan found it payable (go or caution)

found.description: false: not in the Trust Index (see how_to_list)

last.description: Latest day: g go, c caution, n no_go, x unreachable

last_scan.description: The latest verdict, reasons, price and networks

submitted.description: Added by its seller, not listed in a registry

title: x402 Trust Index record (free)
